description: Source file implementing media GPU media client functions for ChromeOS, including platform video decoder creation, support notification, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: GetPreferredRenderableFourccs
methods.description: Returns default preferred renderable Fourcc codes for video decoding.

methods.name: GetActualPlatformDecoderImplementation
methods.description: Determines the platform-specific video decoder implementation based on GPU preferences.

methods.name: CreatePlatformVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific video decoder based on GPU preferences and traits.

methods.name: NotifyPlatformDecoderSupport
methods.description: Notifies support for platform decoder implementation based on GPU preferences.

methods.name: GetPlatformSupportedVideoDecoderConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves supported video decoder configurations for the platform.

methods.name: GetPlatformDecoderImplementationType
methods.description: Returns the type of platform decoder implementation based on GPU info and preferences.

methods.name: CreatePlatformAudioDecoder
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific audio decoder (returns nullptr in this implementation).

methods.name: CreatePlatformAudioEncoder
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific audio encoder (returns nullptr in this implementation).

methods.name: CreatePlatformCdmFactory
methods.description: Creates a Content Decryption Module factory for ChromeOS.
